Instructions

Each item is an RE2 example that no study condition with reasoning answered correctly. Judge from the code and input as given, without running anything, whether the reference output can be derived from them, and pick one verdict. Do not open data/audit/re2_audit.csv or the other reviewer's labels before you finish.

  • Solvable: the reference can be derived. In the reason, say why the models missed it, using their answers below, e.g. the right value in a form the scoring rejects, a long exact computation, a library's output format, or errors in following the code.
  • Input lost: the input lacks state the output depends on, e.g. objects recorded as null or as partial attribute dictionaries, arrays abbreviated with an ellipsis, fitted models or test-local classes not given.
  • Reference misrecorded: the reference is not what the code returns, e.g. a returned object recorded as an attribute dictionary instead of its representation, or an exception or empty list recorded as null.
  • Environment-dependent: the output depends on the execution, e.g. memory addresses in representations, randomness, hash randomization, style or font settings.

Labels are saved in this browser as you go. Export a CSV when done and send it back.
